intent: new independent asset using style inputs
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one independent raster game component icon, not a panel or illustration of the whole board.
Reference roles: Image 1 is the selected B copper-ink formation board, the HIGHEST visual style authority only. Image 2 is a sibling ward component, for consistent ink weight, flat top-down construction, palette and short copper-jaw sockets. Image 3 is a sibling splitter, for the same broad brush-painted copper/gray-jade shapes and three-port vocabulary. These are style/family references, NOT edit targets. Do not reproduce the board or existing components.
Style: match this exact Chinese xianxia game's hand-painted ink icon family. Strong irregular charcoal-black ink contour, broad simplified flat low-saturation gray-brown ancient copper and gray-green jade color masses, dry-brush scumble, small ivory-white bevel edges. Painted two-dimensional read, sparse detail and a strong silhouette readable at 64 px; no photographic metal, realistic microtexture or glossy 3D relief.
View: strictly 90-degree orthographic directly overhead, all pieces lying flat. No camera tilt or visible tall vertical front/side walls.
Backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha outside the object and in open gaps, no black/white colored background, no floor shadow, no floating glow. Center the complete single object with a safe transparent margin.
No writing, letters, numbers, arrows, modern electronic symbols, grid, modern PCB, chip legs, shield silhouette, jewelry, game UI button frame, surrounding board, free wires outside the object, or extra colored attachment points.
Subject: one compact physical inverting latch built from TWO offset, oppositely facing curved gray-green jade tongues hooked against a small gray-brown ancient copper clasp. The two blunt jade crescents counterface and overlap in an unmistakable reversed/opposing arrangement; one ivory-highlighted inner curve contrasts with the other dark inner curve. This is a flat hand-painted mechanical talisman component, not a modern NOT triangle, two arrows, a written character, a yin-yang logo or a decorative medallion.
Native square 1:1 canvas, 1x1 candidate footprint. Exactly TWO small functional sockets, WEST midpoint cinnabar signal input and EAST midpoint cinnabar signal output, on one precise horizontal centerline, each a short red groove held by pale copper jaws at the perimeter. The opposing tongues and copper catches sit between these two mouths. All north/south edges are closed, no other socket or colored contact. No external lines.
